We need to create a 7-day travel plan for two people from North Platte to Colorado, exploring three cities, dates March 20-26, 2022. Budget $6,500. Need to produce plan for each day, calling submit_day_plan for each day (7 calls). Must include city, transportation details, restaurant names for breakfast, lunch, dinner, attractions, accommodation.

We need to pick three cities in Colorado to explore: maybe Denver, Colorado Springs, and Boulder. Starting location North Platte, NE. Travel by car. So Day 1 March 20: depart North Platte, drive to Denver (approx 6-7 hours). So transportation: drive, maybe rental car. Provide details: "Rental Car: Pick up from North Platte, Drive to Denver, Departure 08:00, Arrival 14:30". Accommodation in Denver: maybe an Airbnb that allows parties, private room. Provide name.

Day 2 March 21: Stay in Denver, explore attractions: Denver Botanic Gardens, Red Rocks Amphitheatre (though not in city but near). Breakfast restaurant, lunch, dinner.

Day 3 March 22: Travel from Denver to Colorado Springs (approx 1.5h). Transportation: drive. Accommodation in Colorado Springs.

Day 4 March 23: Explore Colorado Springs: Garden of the Gods, Pikes Peak. Food.

Day 5 March 24: Travel from Colorado Springs to Boulder (approx 2h). Accommodation in Boulder.

Day 6 March 25: Explore Boulder: Pearl Street Mall, Boulder Dushanbe Teahouse. Food.

Day 7 March 26: Return to North Platte? Actually trip ends March 26. Could drive back to North Platte from Boulder (approx 8h). Transportation: drive. No accommodation needed? Could end travel.

We need to fill each day's fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

For days with no transportation (staying), maybe put "-". For day 7 travel back, transportation with details, accommodation maybe "-".

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
